items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: And the guy who had the, uh, the N.O. Ray, uh, Holly Johnson.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, you mean Harry Hopkins from Washington.

Well, sure. The bass shot, man. It was us. Uh, Secretary of Interior. Uh-huh. Harry Lickish, you know. Oh, yeah. And the guy who had the, uh, the N.O. Ray, uh, Holly Johnson. Well, I mean, I'm kind of a historian myself, you know. Yeah, you know. Besides the music, you know. The foot. Pardon? You talk about, oh, yeah, this is what I want to mention, but it was to you. Uh-huh. I don't think hardly anybody has ever mentioned the foot and dance hall. Not yet, yeah. Which, every musician in town played at the foot…
